description.p: Nuclear is a free and open source 2D cut-out animation application built on Grease Pencil, proudly derived from Blender. It focuses on the traditional cut-out workflow: drawing, rigging with pegs, deformers and 2D compositing.
Nuclear is developed by Rapadura Atômica. It is licensed under the GNU General Public License; the full corresponding source code is available in the project repository.
